rationale: The description states that the platform delivers multi-point integrations of big data, which is a concrete conventional integration function. 'Intelligent' alone does not specify AI/ML or explain an AI-dependent operation.
evidence_spans: intelligent integration platform as a service delivers fast, multi-point, modern big data integrations
conflict_response: The adjective 'intelligent' is not sufficient by itself to establish AI, but neither does it negate the explicitly stated integration function. The text identifies the conventional task—multi-point big-data integrations—so the negative is supported under the description-based rule, without asserting an exhaustive feature inventory.
